sentences.en: Nobody wants to play with me.

sentences.text: Warum hat mir keiner etwas gesagt?
sentences.en: Why didn't anybody tell me anything?

meanings.notes: REVIEW warning: The pronoun meanings give base 'keiner' while the entry base is 'kein'. The usual lemma is 'kein'; make the bases consistent.

sentences.text: Ich habe viele Freunde, aber keiner kann mir helfen.
sentences.en: I have lots of friends, but not one of them can help me.

sentences.text: Keiner der Lehrer war heute in der Schule.
sentences.en: None of the teachers was at school today.

meanings.gloss: no, not any (before feminine nouns, dative)

sentences.text: In keiner Stadt ist es so schön wie hier.
sentences.en: No city is as beautiful as here.

sentences.text: Ich habe in keiner Stadt so gut gegessen wie in Rom.
sentences.en: I've never eaten as well in any city as in Rome.
